spans.s:
1. अद् cl. 2. P. अ॑त्ति, आद, अत्स्यति, अत्तुम्, to eat, consume, devour, Ved. Inf. अ॑त्तवे, RV. :
Caus. आद॑यति and ˚ते (once अदयते [ĀpŚr.]) to feed

etym.s: [cf. Lith. edmi; Slav. jamj for jadmj; Gk. ἔδω; Lat. edo; Goth. root AT pres. ita; Germ. essen; Eng. to eat, Arm. utem]

spans.s: 2. अद् mfn. ifc. ‘eating’, as मत्स्याद्, eating fish.
